original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚奥贡州两起交通事故致3死7伤
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚奥贡州萨加穆-伊科罗杜高速公路和奥塔-伊迪罗科路发生两起独立交通事故，共造成3人死亡、7人受伤。奥贡州交通合规与执法机构发言人巴巴通德·阿金比伊证实了上述事故。第一起事故发生在萨加穆-伊科罗杜高速公路Kam Steel路段，一名女子死亡，另有两名女子受伤。

location.site: 萨加穆-伊科罗杜高速公路Kam Steel路段及奥塔-伊迪罗科路Agarawu、Winners路段
location.raw_text: Sagamu-Ikorodu Expressway and the Ota–Idiroko Road in Ogun State

key_facts.fact: 奥贡州两起交通事故共造成3人死亡、7人受伤
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Three persons have been killed, and seven others injured in two separate road crashes along Sagamu-Ikorodu Expressway and the Ota–Idiroko Road in Ogun State.

key_facts.fact: 事故发生在周六，分别位于萨加穆-伊科罗杜高速公路Kam Steel路段和奥塔-伊迪罗科路Agarawu、Winners路段
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The accidents occurred on Saturday at the Kam Steel axis of the Sagamu–Ikorodu Expressway and the Agarawu, Winners axis of the Ota–Idiroko Road.

key_facts.fact: 奥贡州交通合规与执法机构发言人巴巴通德·阿金比伊证实了事故
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The spokesperson for the Ogun State Traffic Compliance and Enforcement Agency, Babatunde Akinbiyi, confirmed the incidents in a traffic update on Saturday.

key_facts.fact: 第一起事故造成一名女子死亡、两名女子受伤
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the first accident occurred at the Kam Steel axis of the Sagamu–Ikorodu Highway, leaving a woman dead and two other women with injuries.

uncertainties: 第二起事故的具体伤亡分布尚未在正文中说明
目前仅单一来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
